sloka: बलि होम अर्चितम् पुण्यम् ब्रह्म घोष निनादितम् ।पुष्पैः च अन्यैः परिक्षिप्तम् पद्मिन्या च स पद्मया ॥३-१-६॥
transliteration: bali homa arcitam puṇyam brahma ghoṣa nināditam ।puṣpaiḥ ca anyaiḥ parikṣiptam padminyā ca sa padmayā ॥3-1-6॥

translations.english: The hermitages where various sacrificial offerings were made reverberated with Vedic chantings. Flowers were scattered all over. There was a lotuspond with lotuses. There were aged, selfrestrained sages glowing like the Sun or the fire, living on fruits and roots, clothed in bark and dark deerskin.
